parameters.content:
## UXR Search tests — real sub-workflow
Click Execute workflow, then open Test Report. Six sequential scenarios call the ORIGINAL UXR Search. No copied search logic, no email sending, no table writes, no schedule or webhook.

Customer.io reads use real data and credentials in UXR Search; execution history may contain profile data. Do not publish this manual runner. Full suite failure is intentional when an assertion fails; report retains expected/actual results. A child workflow error may trigger its existing error handler.

CSV duplicate input uses an eligible address discovered during this run. It tests input normalization and one result per address, NOT a guarantee that conflicting profiles are blocked. Live data is mutable; diagnose red tests before changing expectations.

Before future runs, review UXR Search if its behavior or external actions have changed.

## Parent test runner
Called by Test Runner accepts returnReportOnly=true: failed assertions return a FAIL report instead of throwing, so the parent can aggregate all suites. Manual runs still fail on failed assertions. Unexpected runtime errors are caught by the parent call node. No publication is required for sub-workflow execution.
